violated_contract: Unknown or multilingual speech is not evidence that a fixed-language recognizer supports the audio. A nonempty recognizer response may be wrong-script phonetics and must not be accepted as language correctness.
canonical_prevention: Keep a shared language-capability guard at prerecorded selection and batch intake/worker boundaries. Require independent confident audio-language detection before unknown speech may use Parakeet; route unsupported or uncertain audio to a multilingual provider, retain custody for pre-admitted unsafe units, and gate rollout on route coverage and zero unqualified Parakeet decisions independently of speech-loss metrics.
